messages:
maya: FYI we're doing a rolling runtime + model pin swap across EU then APAC on 2026-03-31. plan: EU start 03:30 UTC, APAC start 07:00 UTC. each region ~45m. goal: minimal disruption but we will broadcast. asking support+ops to prepare comms and banners.
chris: tagging enterprise ops - need SMS + webhook notify for all enterprise contacts 15m before each region start. can we do that?
tina-support: yes. i'll prep 3 assets: 1) short statuspage snippet, 2) customer-friendly email, 3) technical runbook note for platform engineers. will queue SMS and webhook via broadcast service.
ops-lead: runbook notes: snapshot config at T-3h, pre-warm caches at T-1h, run smoke on canaries T-30m. rollback trigger: p95 latency >400ms sustained for 5m OR error-rate >2x baseline for 5m -> immediate pin back to model:release-20260301 + route tiered traffic to hosted-fallback. also feature-flag pin_release_20260331 to flip if we need instant revert.
deploy-bot: ticket MNT-3099 created. scheduled windows: EU start 1790007000 end 1790009700, APAC start 1790022000 end 1790024700. canaries configured to 5% then 25 then 100. will auto-hold on health-check breach. will emit events to #eng-oncall.
status-bot: statuspage draft saved at /ops/status-drafts/MNT-3099. preview link (eng-only): https://internal.redwood/ops/status-drafts/MNT-3099. customer-facing publish scheduled T-20m per region.
tina-support: statuspage snippet (short):
"Planned maintenance: rolling runtime & pinned-model update in EU then APAC. Start times: EU 2026-03-31 03:30 UTC, APAC 07:00 UTC. Expected brief latency increases for a small subset of requests while caches warm. No data changes expected. For SLA-sensitive workloads, contact support@redwood.ai."

Also adding a link to the technical note and live updates.
sven-i18n: will provide localized copies for zh-CN and ja-JP. ping me when english drafts done.
chris: SMS copy OK? "Redwood Inference: brief maintenance in your region starting in 15m. Check email or status.redwood.ai for details." keep short.
tina-support: customer email (friendly) draft:
Subject: "Planned maintenance in your region — short service update"
Body:
Hi there,
We're scheduling a brief rolling maintenance on Mar 31 to apply runtime and pinned-model updates. EU start 03:30 UTC, APAC start 07:00 UTC. Each region window ~45 minutes. You may see short latency spikes or rate limiting while caches warm. No customer data will be modified. If you have strict SLAs please reply to this email or contact support@redwood.ai and we'll coordinate a mitigation plan.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support

tina-support: technical email draft:
Subject: "Rolling runtime + pinned-model swap — EU/APAC (Mar 31)"
Body:
Team,
Window: EU 03:30 UTC, APAC 07:00 UTC. Actions: kernel swap + pinned-model rollout (model:release-20260331). Sequence: canary (5%) -> ramp (25%) -> full (100%) with automatic canary hold. Metrics gating: p95 <=400ms and error-rate <=2x baseline. Rollback behaviour: flip feature-flag pin_release_20260331 to revert and route traffic to hosted-fallback. Post-maint: we'll publish perf deltas and per-model latency/throughput charts. Reach /eng-oncall for live coordination.
ops-lead: please add step to revoke any non-prod keys from prod prior to T-1h. also ensure SLO alerts are temporarily suppressed to avoid noise, but keep escalation paths intact.
maya: confirm we want a 15m enterprise pre-broadcast and 5m in-app banner before each regional start.
chris: yes. also request a targeted webhook to enterprise CI endpoints so they can pause flows if needed.
tina-support: queued broadcast: enterprise T-15m -> reserved T-15m -> self-serve T-10m. in-app banner text (10m prior): "Planned maintenance starting soon in your region. Expect brief latency blips for a small fraction of requests. See status.redwood.ai for details."
deploy-bot: canary auto-hold conditions: health-check fail rate >0.4% over 3m OR p95 >400ms for 5m. will post hold events and recommended action in MNT-3099.
status-bot: live updates will be posted to public status page and internal thread. public updates: will post at T-start, T+15m, T+complete with short notes.
sven-i18n: got it. i'll attach zh/ja drafts to the draft folder when tina posts english final.
ops-lead: prechecks kicking off now in staging. will update MNT-3099 with pass/fail.
maya: thanks all. final checklist: tina publish broadcasts, sven localize, chris SMS/webhook enabled, ops run prechecks, deploy-bot monitor holds. keep MNT-3099 for logs and post-maint release note. keep replies light in this thread. :white_check_mark:
